derived.name: reference_births_relative_change_pct
derived.method: (births[y2-1] / births[y1-1] - 1) x 100; SINASC by mother's residence
derived.label: independent_reference_change

derived.name: state_doses_relative_change_pct
derived.method: (sum doses[y2] / sum doses[y1] - 1) x 100 over 92 units observed in both years (weighted by doses; not an average of municipal percentages)
derived.label: state_benchmark_weighted

derived.name: divergence_from_state_pp
derived.method: unit relative dose change - state relative dose change
derived.label: observed_change

derived.name: back_calculated_denominator_y1
derived.method: doses[y1] / coverage[y1] x 100 (from published, rounded values)
derived.label: back_calculated_not_observed

derived.name: back_calculated_denominator_y2
derived.method: doses[y2] / coverage[y2] x 100 (from published, rounded values)
derived.label: back_calculated_not_observed

derived.name: share_of_log_coverage_change_from_recorded_doses
derived.method: ln(doses[y2]/doses[y1]) / ln(coverage[y2]/coverage[y1]); identity: ln(C2/C1) = ln(N2/N1) - ln(Den2/Den1) with back-calculated denominators
derived.label: mathematical_decomposition

signals.statement: Recorded MMR1 doses changed by -69.4% from 2019 (13396) to 2020 (4096).
cautions: Context: the independent SINASC reference series (D1) changed by -4.9%. It is residence-based and is not the official denominator, so it cannot classify this change as numerator- or denominator-driven.
cannot_conclude: Whether the number of children actually vaccinated changed.
Whether the change reflects vaccination activity, recording, or transmission of records.

signals.statement: The change in recorded doses (-69.4%) differs from the statewide change (-36.4%) by -33.0 percentage points.
cannot_conclude: Why this municipality differs from the state.
Whether the difference reflects vaccination activity or recording.

cautions: Values above 100% can arise when the numerator and denominator are attributed to different places; the value is neither corrected nor interpreted.
cannot_conclude: Which input is inaccurate: numerator and denominator are attributed differently (place of recording vs residence).

signals.statement: Published coverage changed by -85.89 percentage points, from 121.66% in 2019 to 35.77% in 2020.
cautions: Mathematical decomposition (D8): the log change in recorded doses equals 0.97 times the log change in published coverage; the back-calculated denominator accounts for the remainder, which can be negative. This is an identity of published values and cannot establish cause.
cannot_conclude: Whether true coverage changed: the official denominator is unpublished.
Whether the change is driven by the numerator or the denominator in reality; the decomposition is arithmetic only.

limitations.text: Values are recorded administrative activity, not confirmed vaccination uptake.
The official coverage denominator is unpublished; denominators shown here are back-calculated from published values or come from an independent reference series.
Doses are attributed to the municipality where they were recorded; SINASC births to the mother's residence.
Comparisons are limited to 2015-2022 (legacy SI-PNI on TabNet); a reporting-system transition began in 2023.
2020-2021 may combine service disruption with registration-system effects; the data cannot separate them.
No facility-level reporting completeness is available in this source.

prohibited_interpretations: Stating that fewer (or more) children were vaccinated.
Attributing a change to a cause (e.g. vaccine hesitancy, supply shortages, staffing, missed vaccinations, reporting failures) without independent evidence.
Describing a back-calculated denominator as observed or as verified SINASC births.
Classifying a change as numerator-driven or denominator-driven.
Presenting a recalculated percentage as official coverage.
Comparing values across the 2023 reporting-system transition.
